<h1 id="xero-accounting-api">Xero Accounting API v19.1.0</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

Base URLs:

* <a href="https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0">https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0</a> - The Xero Accounting API exposes accounting and related functions of the main Xero application and can be used for a variety of purposes such as creating transactions like invoices and credit notes, right through to extracting accounting data via our reports endpoint.

<a href="https://developer.xero.com/xero-developer-platform-terms-conditions/">Terms of service</a>
Email: <a href="mailto:api@xero.com">Xero Platform Team</a> 
Web: <a href="https://developer.xero.com">Xero Platform Team</a> 

# Authentication

- oAuth2 authentication. For more information

    - Flow: authorizationCode
    - Authorization URL = [https://login.xero.com/identity/connect/authorize](https://login.xero.com/identity/connect/authorize)
    - Token URL = [https://identity.xero.com/connect/token](https://identity.xero.com/connect/token)

|Scope|Scope Description|
|---|---|
|email|Grant read-only access to your email|
|openid|Grant read-only access to your open id|
|profile|your profile information|
|accounting.attachments|Grant read-write access to attachments|
|accounting.attachments.read|Grant read-only access to attachments|
|accounting.budgets.read|Grant read-only access to read budgets|
|accounting.contacts|Grant read-write access to contacts and contact groups|
|accounting.contacts.read|Grant read-only access to contacts and contact groups|
|accounting.journals.read|Grant read-only access to journals|
|accounting.reports.read|Grant read-only access to accounting reports|
|accounting.reports.tenninetynine.read|Grant read-only access to 1099 reports|
|accounting.settings|Grant read-write access to organisation and account settings|
|accounting.settings.read|Grant read-only access to organisation and account settings|
|accounting.transactions|Grant read-write access to bank transactions, credit notes, invoices, repeating invoices|
|accounting.transactions.read|Grant read-only access to invoices|
|paymentservices|Grant read-write access to payment services|

<h1 id="xero-accounting-api-accounting">Accounting</h1>

## Retrieves the full chart of accounts

<a id="opIdgetAccounts"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Accounts \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /Accounts`

<h3 id="retrieves-the-full-chart-of-accounts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|If-Modified-Since|header|string(date-time)|false|Only records created or modified since this timestamp will be returned|
|where|query|string|false|Filter by an any element|
|order|query|string|false|Order by an any element|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Accounts": [
    {
      "AccountID": "ebd06280-af70-4bed-97c6-7451a454ad85",
      "Code": "091",
      "Name": "Business Savings Account",
      "Type": "BANK",
      "TaxType": "NONE",
      "EnablePaymentsToAccount": false,
      "BankAccountNumber": "0209087654321050",
      "BankAccountType": "BANK",
      "CurrencyCode": "NZD"
    },
    {
      "AccountID": "7d05a53d-613d-4eb2-a2fc-dcb6adb80b80",
      "Code": "200",
      "Name": "Sales",
      "Type": "REVENUE",
      "TaxType": "OUTPUT2",
      "Description": "Income from any normal business activity",
      "EnablePaymentsToAccount": false
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="retrieves-the-full-chart-of-accounts-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success - return response of type Accounts array with 0 to n Account|[Accounts](#schemaaccounts)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: accounting.settings accounting.settings.read )
</aside>

## Creates a new chart of accounts

<a id="opIdcreateAccount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Accounts \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID' \
  -d '{
    "Code": "123456",
    "Name": "Foobar",
    "Type": "EXPENSE",
    "Description": "Hello World"
  }'
```

`PUT /Accounts`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Code": "123456",
  "Name": "Foobar",
  "Type": "EXPENSE",
  "Description": "Hello World"
}
```

<h3 id="creates-a-new-chart-of-accounts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|This allows you to safely retry requests without the risk of duplicate processing. 128 character max.|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|
|body|body|[Account](#schemaaccount)|true|Account object in body of request|
|» Code|body|string|false|Customer defined alpha numeric account code e.g 200 or SALES (max length = 10)|
|» Name|body|string|false|Name of account (max length = 150)|
|» AccountID|body|string(uuid)|false|The Xero identifier for an account – specified as a string following  the endpoint name   e.g. /297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9|
|» Type|body|[AccountType](#schemaaccounttype)|false|See Account Types|
|» BankAccountNumber|body|string|false|For bank accounts only (Account Type BANK)|
|» Status|body|string|false|Accounts with a status of ACTIVE can be updated to ARCHIVED. See Account Status Codes|
|» Description|body|string|false|Description of the Account. Valid for all types of accounts except bank accounts (max length = 4000)|
|» BankAccountType|body|string|false|For bank accounts only. See Bank Account types|
|» CurrencyCode|body|[CurrencyCode](#schemacurrencycode)|false|3 letter alpha code for the currency – see list of currency codes|
|» TaxType|body|string|false|The tax type from taxRates|
|» EnablePaymentsToAccount|body|boolean|false|Boolean – describes whether account can have payments applied to it|
|» ShowInExpenseClaims|body|boolean|false|Boolean – describes whether account code is available for use with expense claims|
|» ReportingCode|body|string|false|Shown if set|
|» AddToWatchlist|body|boolean|false|Boolean – describes whether the account is shown in the watchlist widget on the dashboard|
|» ValidationErrors|body|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|Displays array of validation error messages from the API|

## Retrieves a single chart of accounts by using a unique account Id

<a id="opIdgetAccount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Accounts/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /Accounts/{AccountID}`

<h3 id="retrieves-a-single-chart-of-accounts-by-using-a-unique-account-id-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountID|path|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier for Account object|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Id": "323455cc-9511-4451-a873-248d2983f38e",
  "Status": "OK",
  "ProviderName": "Xero API Partner",
  "DateTimeUTC": "/Date(1550797359081)/",
  "Accounts": [
    {
      "AccountID": "99ce6032-0678-4aa0-8148-240c75fee33a",
      "Code": "123456",
      "Name": "FooBar",
      "Status": "ACTIVE",
      "Type": "EXPENSE",
      "TaxType": "INPUT",
      "Description": "Hello World",
      "Class": "EXPENSE",
      "EnablePaymentsToAccount": false,
      "ShowInExpenseClaims": false,
      "ReportingCode": "EXP",
      "ReportingCodeName": "Expense",
      "UpdatedDateUTC": "/Date(1550797359120+0000)/"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="retrieves-a-single-chart-of-accounts-by-using-a-unique-account-id-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success - return response of type Accounts array with one Account|[Accounts](#schemaaccounts)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: accounting.settings accounting.settings.read )
</aside>

## Updates a chart of accounts

<a id="opIdupdateAccount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Accounts/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID' \
  -d '{
    "Accounts": [
      {
        "Code": "123456",
        "Name": "BarFoo",
        "AccountID": "99ce6032-0678-4aa0-8148-240c75fee33a",
        "Type": "EXPENSE",
        "Description": "GoodBye World",
        "TaxType": "INPUT",
        "EnablePaymentsToAccount": false,
        "ShowInExpenseClaims": false,
        "Class": "EXPENSE",
        "ReportingCode": "EXP",
        "ReportingCodeName": "Expense",
        "UpdatedDateUTC": "2019-02-21T16:29:47.96-08:00"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /Accounts/{AccountID}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Accounts": [
    {
      "Code": "123456",
      "Name": "BarFoo",
      "AccountID": "99ce6032-0678-4aa0-8148-240c75fee33a",
      "Type": "EXPENSE",
      "Description": "GoodBye World",
      "TaxType": "INPUT",
      "EnablePaymentsToAccount": false,
      "ShowInExpenseClaims": false,
      "Class": "EXPENSE",
      "ReportingCode": "EXP",
      "ReportingCodeName": "Expense",
      "UpdatedDateUTC": "2019-02-21T16:29:47.96-08:00"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="updates-a-chart-of-accounts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|AccountID|path|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier for Account object|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|This allows you to safely retry requests without the risk of duplicate processing. 128 character max.|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|
|body|body|[Accounts](#schemaaccounts)|true|Request of type Accounts array with one Account|
|» Accounts|body|[[Account](#schemaaccount)]|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Id": "9012e75c-ec08-40a9-ae15-153fc1f35c4d",
  "Status": "OK",

    {
      "AccountID": "99ce6032-0678-4aa0-8148-240c75fee33a",
      "Code": "654321",
      "Name": "BarFoo",

      "Type": "EXPENSE",
      "TaxType": "INPUT",
      "Description": "Good Bye World",
      "Class": "EXPENSE",
      "EnablePaymentsToAccount": false,
      "ShowInExpenseClaims": false,
      "ReportingCode": "EXP",
      "ReportingCodeName": "Expense",
      "UpdatedDateUTC": "/Date(1550795389333+0000)/"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "ErrorNumber": 10,
  "Type": "ValidationException",
  "Message": "A validation exception occurred",
  "Elements": [
    {
      "AccountID": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
      "Code": "123456",
      "Name": "Foobar",
      "Type": "EXPENSE",

          "Message": "Please enter a unique Name."
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

## Retrieves all contacts in a Xero organisation

<a id="opIdgetContacts"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Contacts \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /Contacts`

<h3 id="retrieves-all-contacts-in-a-xero-organisation-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|If-Modified-Since|header|string(date-time)|false|Only records created or modified since this timestamp will be returned|
|where|query|string|false|Filter by an any element|
|order|query|string|false|Order by an any element|
|IDs|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Filter by a comma separated list of ContactIDs. Allows you to retrieve a specific set of contacts in a single call.|
|page|query|integer|false|e.g. page=1 - Up to 100 contacts will be returned in a single API call.|
|includeArchived|query|boolean|false|e.g. includeArchived=true - Contacts with a status of ARCHIVED will be included in the response|
|summaryOnly|query|boolean|false|Use summaryOnly=true in GET Contacts and Invoices endpoint to retrieve a smaller version of the response object. This returns only lightweight fields, excluding computation-heavy fields from the response, making the API calls quick and efficient.|
|searchTerm|query|string|false|Search parameter that performs a case-insensitive text search across the Name, FirstName, LastName, ContactNumber and EmailAddress fields.|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|Number of records to retrieve per page|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

## Updates a specific contact in a Xero organisation

<a id="opIdupdateContact"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Contacts/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID' \
  -d '{
    "Contacts": [
      {
        "ContactID": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
        "Name": "Thanos"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /Contacts/{ContactID}`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Contacts": [
    {
      "ContactID": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
      "Name": "Thanos"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="updates-a-specific-contact-in-a-xero-organisation-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|This allows you to safely retry requests without the risk of duplicate processing. 128 character max.|
|ContactID|path|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier for a Contact|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|
|body|body|[Contacts](#schemacontacts)|true|an array of Contacts containing single Contact object with properties to update|
|» pagination|body|[Pagination](#schemapagination)|false|none|
|» Warnings|body|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|Displays array of warning messages from the API|
|» Contacts|body|[[Contact](#schemacontact)]|false|none|

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/CreditNotes \
```

## Retrieves sales invoices or purchase bills

<a id="opIdgetInvoices"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Invoices \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /Invoices`

<h3 id="retrieves-sales-invoices-or-purchase-bills-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|If-Modified-Since|header|string(date-time)|false|Only records created or modified since this timestamp will be returned|
|where|query|string|false|Filter by an any element|
|order|query|string|false|Order by an any element|
|IDs|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Filter by a comma-separated list of InvoicesIDs.|
|InvoiceNumbers|query|[string]|false|Filter by a comma-separated list of InvoiceNumbers.|
|ContactIDs|query|[string(uuid)]|false|Filter by a comma-separated list of ContactIDs.|
|Statuses|query|[string]|false|Filter by a comma-separated list Statuses. For faster response times we recommend using these explicit parameters instead of passing OR conditions into the Where filter.|
|page|query|integer|false|e.g. page=1 – Up to 100 invoices will be returned in a single API call with line items shown for each invoice|
|includeArchived|query|boolean|false|e.g. includeArchived=true - Invoices with a status of ARCHIVED will be included in the response|
|createdByMyApp|query|boolean|false|When set to true you'll only retrieve Invoices created by your app|
|unitdp|query|integer|false|e.g. unitdp=4 – (Unit Decimal Places) You can opt in to use four decimal places for unit amounts|
|summaryOnly|query|boolean|false|Use summaryOnly=true in GET Contacts and Invoices endpoint to retrieve a smaller version of the response object. This returns only lightweight fields, excluding computation-heavy fields from the response, making the API calls quick and efficient.|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|Number of records to retrieve per page|
|searchTerm|query|string|false|Search parameter that performs a case-insensitive text search across the fields e.g. InvoiceNumber, Reference.|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

<a id="opIdcreateInvoices"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Invoices \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID' \
  -d '{
    "Invoices": [
      {
        "Type": "ACCREC",
        "Contact": {
          "ContactID": "430fa14a-f945-44d3-9f97-5df5e28441b8"
        },
        "LineItems": [
          {
            "Description": "Acme Tires",
            "Quantity": 2,
            "UnitAmount": 20,
            "AccountCode": "200",
            "TaxType": "NONE",
            "LineAmount": 40
          }
        ],
        "Date": "2019-03-11",
        "DueDate": "2018-12-10",
        "Reference": "Website Design",
        "Status": "AUTHORISED"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /Invoices`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Invoices": [
    {
      "Type": "ACCREC",
      "Contact": {
        "ContactID": "430fa14a-f945-44d3-9f97-5df5e28441b8"
```

<h3 id="creates-one-or-more-sales-invoices-or-purchase-bills-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|summarizeErrors|query|boolean|false|If false return 200 OK and mix of successfully created objects and any with validation errors|
|unitdp|query|integer|false|e.g. unitdp=4 – (Unit Decimal Places) You can opt in to use four decimal places for unit amounts|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|This allows you to safely retry requests without the risk of duplicate processing. 128 character max.|
|allowBackorders|query|boolean|false|Allows an invoice to be created even when one or more line items contain tracked inventory where the invoice quantity would cause the available quantity to go negative|

|body|body|[Invoices](#schemainvoices)|true|Invoices with an array of invoice objects in body of request|
|» pagination|body|[Pagination](#schemapagination)|false|none|
|» Warnings|body|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|Displays array of warning messages from the API|
|» Invoices|body|[[Invoice](#schemainvoice)]|false|none|

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Invoices \

  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID' \
  -d '{
    "Invoices": [
      {
        "Type": "ACCREC",
        "Contact": {
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

## Retrieves items

<a id="opIdgetItems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Items \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /Items`

<h3 id="retrieves-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|If-Modified-Since|header|string(date-time)|false|Only records created or modified since this timestamp will be returned|
|where|query|string|false|Filter by an any element|
|order|query|string|false|Order by an any element|
|unitdp|query|integer|false|e.g. unitdp=4 – (Unit Decimal Places) You can opt in to use four decimal places for unit amounts|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

## Creates one or more items

<a id="opIdcreateItems"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Items \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID' \
  -d '{
    "Items": [
      {
        "Code": "code123",
        "Name": "Item Name XYZ",
        "Description": "Foobar",
        "InventoryAssetAccountCode": "140",
        "PurchaseDetails": {
          "COGSAccountCode": "500"
        }
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /Items`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Items": [
    {
      "Code": "code123",
      "Name": "Item Name XYZ",
      "Description": "Foobar",
      "InventoryAssetAccountCode": "140",
      "PurchaseDetails": {
        "COGSAccountCode": "500"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="creates-one-or-more-items-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|summarizeErrors|query|boolean|false|If false return 200 OK and mix of successfully created objects and any with validation errors|
|unitdp|query|integer|false|e.g. unitdp=4 – (Unit Decimal Places) You can opt in to use four decimal places for unit amounts|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|This allows you to safely retry requests without the risk of duplicate processing. 128 character max.|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|
|body|body|[Items](#schemaitems)|true|Items with an array of Item objects in body of request|
|» Items|body|[[Item](#schemaitem)]|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Id": "ae7ef7c8-9024-4d42-8d59-5f26ed3f508b",
  "Status": "OK",
  "ProviderName": "Provider Name Example",
  "DateTimeUTC": "/Date(1552331871904)/",
  "Items": [
    {
      "ItemID": "a4544d51-48f6-441f-a623-99ecbced6ab7",
      "Code": "abc65591",
      "Description": "foobar",
      "UpdatedDateUTC": "/Date(1552331871707)/",
      "PurchaseDetails": {},
      "SalesDetails": {},
      "Name": "Hello11350",

      "IsSold": true,
      "IsPurchased": true,
      "ValidationErrors": [
        {
          "Message": "Price List Item with Code ''abc'' already exists"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
  "ErrorNumber": 0,
  "Type": "string",
  "Message": "string",
  "Elements": [
    {
      "ValidationErrors": [
        {
          "Message": "string"
        }
      ],
      "BatchPaymentID": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
```

## Retrieves journals

<a id="opIdgetJournals"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Journals \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /Journals`

<h3 id="retrieves-journals-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|If-Modified-Since|header|string(date-time)|false|Only records created or modified since this timestamp will be returned|
|offset|query|integer|false|Offset by a specified journal number. e.g. journals with a JournalNumber greater than the offset will be returned|
|paymentsOnly|query|boolean|false|Filter to retrieve journals on a cash basis. Journals are returned on an accrual basis by default.|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Id": "49a09a97-df50-4679-8043-02c86e0dcf5f",
  "Status": "OK",
```

## Retrieves linked transactions (billable expenses)

<a id="opIdgetLinkedTransactions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/LinkedTransactions \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /LinkedTransactions`

<h3 id="retrieves-linked-transactions-billable-expenses-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page|query|integer|false|Up to 100 linked transactions will be returned in a single API call. Use the page parameter to specify the page to be returned e.g. page=1.|
|LinkedTransactionID|query|string(uuid)|false|The Xero identifier for an Linked Transaction|
|SourceTransactionID|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter by the SourceTransactionID. Get the linked transactions created from a particular ACCPAY invoice|
|ContactID|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter by the ContactID. Get all the linked transactions that have been assigned to a particular customer.|
|Status|query|string|false|Filter by the combination of ContactID and Status. Get  the linked transactions associated to a  customer and with a status|
|TargetTransactionID|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter by the TargetTransactionID. Get all the linked transactions allocated to a particular ACCREC invoice|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Id": "516aabd0-e670-48d5-b0eb-10dce4494dd8",
  "Status": "OK",
  "ProviderName": "Provider Name Example",
  "DateTimeUTC": "/Date(1552348338096)/",
  "LinkedTransactions": [
    {
      "LinkedTransactionID": "5cf7d9c0-b9a7-4433-a2dc-ae3c11bba39b",
      "SourceTransactionID": "aec416dd-38ea-40dc-9f0b-813c8c71f87f",
      "SourceLineItemID": "77e0b23b-5b79-4f4b-ae20-c9031d41442f",
      "ContactID": "430fa14a-f945-44d3-9f97-5df5e28441b8",
      "TargetTransactionID": "83693fc1-5b05-4807-b190-109d4a85dd5f",
      "TargetLineItemID": "d5128ff1-0f39-4d2a-a6d5-46dfaf5f075c",
      "Status": "ONDRAFT",
      "Type": "BILLABLEEXPENSE",
      "UpdatedDateUTC": "/Date(1552347991000+0000)/",
      "SourceTransactionTypeCode": "ACCPAY"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="retrieves-linked-transactions-billable-expenses-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success - return response of type LinkedTransactions array with all LinkedTransaction|[LinkedTransactions](#schemalinkedtransactions)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: accounting.transactions accounting.transactions.read )
</aside>

## Creates linked transactions (billable expenses)

<a id="opIdcreateLinkedTransaction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/LinkedTransactions \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID' \
  -d '{
    "LinkedTransactions": [
      {
        "SourceTransactionID": "a848644a-f20f-4630-98c3-386bd7505631",
        "SourceLineItemID": "b0df260d-3cc8-4ced-9bd6-41924f624ed3"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /LinkedTransactions`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "LinkedTransactions": [
    {
      "SourceTransactionID": "a848644a-f20f-4630-98c3-386bd7505631",
      "SourceLineItemID": "b0df260d-3cc8-4ced-9bd6-41924f624ed3"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="creates-linked-transactions-billable-expenses-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|This allows you to safely retry requests without the risk of duplicate processing. 128 character max.|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|
|body|body|[LinkedTransaction](#schemalinkedtransaction)|true|LinkedTransaction object in body of request|
|» SourceTransactionID|body|string(uuid)|false|Filter by the SourceTransactionID. Get all the linked transactions created from a particular ACCPAY invoice|
|» SourceLineItemID|body|string(uuid)|false|The line item identifier from the source transaction.|
|» ContactID|body|string(uuid)|false|Filter by the combination of ContactID and Status. Get all the linked transactions that have been assigned to a particular customer and have a particular status e.g. GET /LinkedTransactions?ContactID=4bb34b03-3378-4bb2-a0ed-6345abf3224e&Status=APPROVED.|
|» TargetTransactionID|body|string(uuid)|false|Filter by the TargetTransactionID. Get all the linked transactions  allocated to a particular ACCREC invoice|
|» TargetLineItemID|body|string(uuid)|false|The line item identifier from the target transaction. It is possible  to link multiple billable expenses to the same TargetLineItemID.|
|» LinkedTransactionID|body|string(uuid)|false|The Xero identifier for an Linked Transaction e.g./LinkedTransactions/297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9|
|» Status|body|string|false|Filter by the combination of ContactID and Status. Get all the linked transactions that have been assigned to a particular customer and have a particular status e.g. GET /LinkedTransactions?ContactID=4bb34b03-3378-4bb2-a0ed-6345abf3224e&Status=APPROVED.|
|» Type|body|string|false|This will always be BILLABLEEXPENSE. More types may be added in future.|
|» SourceTransactionTypeCode|body|string|false|The Type of the source tranasction. This will be ACCPAY if the linked transaction was created from an invoice and SPEND if it was created from a bank transaction.|
|» ValidationErrors|body|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|Displays array of validation error messages from the API|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» Status|APPROVED|
|» Status|DRAFT|
|» Status|ONDRAFT|
|» Status|BILLED|
|» Status|VOIDED|
|» Type|BILLABLEEXPENSE|
|» SourceTransactionTypeCode|ACCPAY|
|» SourceTransactionTypeCode|SPEND|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Id": "f32b30e5-32d1-42a8-bcc9-5b22828f725c",
  "Status": "OK",
  "ProviderName": "Provider Name Example",
  "DateTimeUTC": "/Date(1552351054646)/",
  "LinkedTransactions": [
    {
      "LinkedTransactionID": "e9684b6c-4df9-45a0-917b-85cc29857008",
      "SourceTransactionID": "a848644a-f20f-4630-98c3-386bd7505631",
      "SourceLineItemID": "b0df260d-3cc8-4ced-9bd6-41924f624ed3",
      "Status": "DRAFT",
      "Type": "BILLABLEEXPENSE",
      "UpdatedDateUTC": "/Date(1552351055000+0000)/",
      "SourceTransactionTypeCode": "ACCPAY",
      "ValidationErrors": [
        {
          "Message": "The SourceLineItemID and SourceTransactionID do not match"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "ErrorNumber": 0,
  "Type": "string",
  "Message": "string",
  "Elements": [
    {
      "ValidationErrors": [
        {
          "Message": "string"
        }
      ],
      "BatchPaymentID": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "BankTransactionID": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "CreditNoteID": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "ContactID": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "InvoiceID": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "ItemID": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "PurchaseOrderID": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="creates-linked-transactions-billable-expenses-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success - return response of type LinkedTransactions array with newly created LinkedTransaction|[LinkedTransactions](#schemalinkedtransactions)|
|400|Bad Request|A failed request due to validation error|[Error](#schemaerror)|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: accounting.transactions )

## Retrieves overpayments

<a id="opIdgetOverpayments"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Overpayments \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \

  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /Overpayments`

<h3 id="retrieves-overpayments-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|---|---|---|---|---|
|If-Modified-Since|header|string(date-time)|false|Only records created or modified since this timestamp will be returned|
|where|query|string|false|Filter by an any element|
|order|query|string|false|Order by an any element|
|page|query|integer|false|e.g. page=1 – Up to 100 overpayments will be returned in a single API call with line items shown for each overpayment|
|unitdp|query|integer|false|e.g. unitdp=4 – (Unit Decimal Places) You can opt in to use four decimal places for unit amounts|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|Number of records to retrieve per page|
|References|query|[string]|false|Filter by a comma-separated list of References|

## Creates a single allocation for a specific overpayment

<a id="opIdcreateOverpaymentAllocations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Overpayments/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/Allocations \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID' \
  -d '{
    "Allocations": [
      {
        "Invoice": {
          "InvoiceID": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
          "LineItems": [],
          "Contact": {},
          "Type": "ACCPAY"
        },
        "Amount": 10,
        "Date": "2019-03-12"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`PUT /Overpayments/{OverpaymentID}/Allocations`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Allocations": [
    {
      "Invoice": {
        "InvoiceID": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
        "LineItems": [],
        "Contact": {},
        "Type": "ACCPAY"
      },
      "Amount": 10,
      "Date": "2019-03-12"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="creates-a-single-allocation-for-a-specific-overpayment-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|OverpaymentID|path|string(uuid)|true|Unique identifier for a Overpayment|
|summarizeErrors|query|boolean|false|If false return 200 OK and mix of successfully created objects and any with validation errors|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|This allows you to safely retry requests without the risk of duplicate processing. 128 character max.|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|
|body|body|[Allocations](#schemaallocations)|true|Allocations array with Allocation object in body of request|
|» Allocations|body|[[Allocation](#schemaallocation)]|false|none|

```json
        "ID": "ed7f6041-c915-4667-bd1d-54c48e92161e",
        "LineItems": []
      },
      "ValidationErrors": []
```

## Creates a single payment for invoice or credit notes

<a id="opIdcreatePayment"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Payments \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID' \
  -d '{
    "Payments": [
      {
        "Invoice": {
          "LineItems": [],
          "InvoiceID": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
        },
        "Account": {
          "Code": "970"
        },
        "Date": "2019-03-12",
        "Amount": 1
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /Payments`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "Payments": [
    {
      "Invoice": {
        "LineItems": [],
        "InvoiceID": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
      },
      "Account": {
        "Code": "970"
      },
      "Date": "2019-03-12",
      "Amount": 1
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="creates-a-single-payment-for-invoice-or-credit-notes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|This allows you to safely retry requests without the risk of duplicate processing. 128 character max.|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|
|body|body|[Payment](#schemapayment)|true|Request body with a single Payment object|
|» Invoice|body|[Invoice](#schemainvoice)|false|none|
|» CreditNote|body|[CreditNote](#schemacreditnote)|false|none|
|» Prepayment|body|[Prepayment](#schemaprepayment)|false|none|
|» Overpayment|body|[Overpayment](#schemaoverpayment)|false|none|
|» InvoiceNumber|body|string|false|Number of invoice or credit note you are applying payment to e.g.INV-4003|
|» CreditNoteNumber|body|string|false|Number of invoice or credit note you are applying payment to e.g. INV-4003|
|» BatchPayment|body|[BatchPayment](#schemabatchpayment)|false|none|
|» Account|body|[Account](#schemaaccount)|false|none|
|» Code|body|string|false|Code of account you are using to make the payment e.g. 001 (note- not all accounts have a code value)|
|» Date|body|string|false|Date the payment is being made (YYYY-MM-DD) e.g. 2009-09-06|
|» CurrencyRate|body|number(double)|false|Exchange rate when payment is received. Only used for non base currency invoices and credit notes e.g. 0.7500|
|» Amount|body|number(double)|false|The amount of the payment. Must be less than or equal to the outstanding amount owing on the invoice e.g. 200.00|
|» BankAmount|body|number(double)|false|The amount of the payment in the currency of the bank account.|
|» Reference|body|string|false|An optional description for the payment e.g. Direct Debit|
|» IsReconciled|body|boolean|false|An optional parameter for the payment. A boolean indicating whether you would like the payment to be created as reconciled when using PUT, or whether a payment has been reconciled when using GET|
|» Status|body|string|false|The status of the payment.|
|» PaymentID|body|string(uuid)|false|The Xero identifier for an Payment e.g. 297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9|
|» BatchPaymentID|body|string(uuid)|false|Present if the payment was created as part of a batch.|
|» BankAccountNumber|body|string|false|The suppliers bank account number the payment is being made to|
|» Particulars|body|string|false|The suppliers bank account number the payment is being made to|
|» Details|body|string|false|The information to appear on the supplier's bank account|
|» HasAccount|body|boolean|false|A boolean to indicate if a contact has an validation errors|
|» HasValidationErrors|body|boolean|false|A boolean to indicate if a contact has an validation errors|
|» StatusAttributeString|body|string|false|A string to indicate if a invoice status|
|» ValidationErrors|body|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|Displays array of validation error messages from the API|
|» Warnings|body|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|Displays array of warning messages from the API|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» Status|AUTHORISED|
|» Status|DELETED|

|order|query|string|false|Order by an any element|

|unitdp|query|integer|false|e.g. unitdp=4 – (Unit Decimal Places) You can opt in to use four decimal places for unit amounts|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|Number of records to retrieve per page|
|InvoiceNumbers|query|[string]|false|Filter by a comma-separated list of InvoiceNumbers|
|References|query|[string]|false|Filter by a comma-separated list of References|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

```json
          "LineItems": [],
```

## Retrieves purchase orders

<a id="opIdgetPurchaseOrders"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/PurchaseOrders \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /PurchaseOrders`

<h3 id="retrieves-purchase-orders-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|If-Modified-Since|header|string(date-time)|false|Only records created or modified since this timestamp will be returned|
|Status|query|string|false|Filter by purchase order status|
|DateFrom|query|string|false|Filter by purchase order date (e.g. GET https://.../PurchaseOrders?DateFrom=2015-12-01&DateTo=2015-12-31|
|DateTo|query|string|false|Filter by purchase order date (e.g. GET https://.../PurchaseOrders?DateFrom=2015-12-01&DateTo=2015-12-31|
|order|query|string|false|Order by an any element|
|page|query|integer|false|To specify a page, append the page parameter to the URL e.g. ?page=1. If there are 100 records in the response you will need to check if there is any more data by fetching the next page e.g ?page=2 and continuing this process until no more results are returned.|
|pageSize|query|integer|false|Number of records to retrieve per page|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Status|DRAFT|
|Status|SUBMITTED|
|Status|AUTHORISED|
|Status|BILLED|
|Status|DELETED|

## Retrieves sales quotes

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Quotes \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /Quotes`

<h3 id="retrieves-sales-quotes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|If-Modified-Since|header|string(date-time)|false|Only records created or modified since this timestamp will be returned|
|DateFrom|query|string(date)|false|Filter for quotes after a particular date|
|DateTo|query|string(date)|false|Filter for quotes before a particular date|
|ExpiryDateFrom|query|string(date)|false|Filter for quotes expiring after a particular date|
|ExpiryDateTo|query|string(date)|false|Filter for quotes before a particular date|
|ContactID|query|string(uuid)|false|Filter for quotes belonging to a particular contact|
|Status|query|string|false|Filter for quotes of a particular Status|
|page|query|integer|false|e.g. page=1 – Up to 100 Quotes will be returned in a single API call with line items shown for each quote|
|order|query|string|false|Order by an any element|
|QuoteNumber|query|string|false|Filter by quote number (e.g. GET https://.../Quotes?QuoteNumber=QU-0001)|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

## Retrieves report for aged payables by contact

`GET /Reports/AgedPayablesByContact`

<h3 id="retrieves-report-for-aged-payables-by-contact-parameters">Parameters</h3>

## Retrieves report for balancesheet

<a id="opIdgetReportBalanceSheet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Reports/BalanceSheet \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /Reports/BalanceSheet`

<h3 id="retrieves-report-for-balancesheet-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|date|query|string(date)|false|The date of the Balance Sheet report|
|periods|query|integer|false|The number of periods for the Balance Sheet report|
|timeframe|query|string|false|The period size to compare to (MONTH, QUARTER, YEAR)|
|trackingOptionID1|query|string|false|The tracking option 1 for the Balance Sheet report|
|trackingOptionID2|query|string|false|The tracking option 2 for the Balance Sheet report|
|standardLayout|query|boolean|false|The standard layout boolean for the Balance Sheet report|
|paymentsOnly|query|boolean|false|return a cash basis for the Balance Sheet report|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|timeframe|MONTH|
|timeframe|QUARTER|
|timeframe|YEAR|

## Retrieves report for bank summary

<a id="opIdgetReportBankSummary"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Reports/BankSummary \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /Reports/BankSummary`

<h3 id="retrieves-report-for-bank-summary-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fromDate|query|string(date)|false|filter by the from date of the report e.g. 2021-02-01|
|toDate|query|string(date)|false|filter by the to date of the report e.g. 2021-02-28|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

## Retrieves a specific report using a unique ReportID

<a id="opIdgetReportFromId"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Reports/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /Reports/{ReportID}`

<h3 id="retrieves-a-specific-report-using-a-unique-reportid-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ReportID|path|string|true|Unique identifier for a Report|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

## Retrieves report for budget summary

<a id="opIdgetReportBudgetSummary"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Reports/BudgetSummary \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /Reports/BudgetSummary`

<h3 id="retrieves-report-for-budget-summary-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|date|query|string(date)|false|The date for the Bank Summary report e.g. 2018-03-31|

## Retrieves report for profit and loss

<a id="opIdgetReportProfitAndLoss"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Reports/ProfitAndLoss \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /Reports/ProfitAndLoss`

<h3 id="retrieves-report-for-profit-and-loss-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|fromDate|query|string(date)|false|filter by the from date of the report e.g. 2021-02-01|
|toDate|query|string(date)|false|filter by the to date of the report e.g. 2021-02-28|
|periods|query|integer|false|The number of periods to compare (integer between 1 and 12)|
|timeframe|query|string|false|The period size to compare to (MONTH, QUARTER, YEAR)|
|trackingCategoryID|query|string|false|The trackingCategory 1 for the ProfitAndLoss report|
|trackingCategoryID2|query|string|false|The trackingCategory 2 for the ProfitAndLoss report|
|trackingOptionID|query|string|false|The tracking option 1 for the ProfitAndLoss report|
|trackingOptionID2|query|string|false|The tracking option 2 for the ProfitAndLoss report|
|standardLayout|query|boolean|false|Return the standard layout for the ProfitAndLoss report|
|paymentsOnly|query|boolean|false|Return cash only basis for the ProfitAndLoss report|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|timeframe|MONTH|
|timeframe|QUARTER|
|timeframe|YEAR|

## Sets the chart of accounts, the conversion date and conversion balances

<a id="opIdpostSetup"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/Setup \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID' \
  -d '{
    "ConversionDate": {},
    "ConversionBalances": [],
    "Accounts": [
      {
        "Code": "200",
        "Name": "Sales",
        "Type": "SALES",
        "ReportingCode": "REV.TRA.GOO"
      },
      {
        "Code": "400",
        "Name": "Advertising",
        "Type": "OVERHEADS",
        "ReportingCode": "EXP"
      },
      {
        "Code": "610",
        "Name": "Accounts Receivable",
        "Type": "CURRENT",
        "SystemAccount": "DEBTORS",
        "ReportingCode": "ASS.CUR.REC.TRA"
      },
      {
        "Code": "800",
        "Name": "Accounts Payable",
        "Type": "CURRLIAB",
        "SystemAccount": "CREDITORS",
        "ReportingCode": "LIA.CUR.PAY"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /Setup`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "ConversionDate": {},
  "ConversionBalances": [],
  "Accounts": [
    {
      "Code": "200",
      "Name": "Sales",
      "Type": "SALES",
      "ReportingCode": "REV.TRA.GOO"
    },
    {
      "Code": "400",
      "Name": "Advertising",
      "Type": "OVERHEADS",
      "ReportingCode": "EXP"
    },
    {
      "Code": "610",
      "Name": "Accounts Receivable",
      "Type": "CURRENT",
      "SystemAccount": "DEBTORS",
      "ReportingCode": "ASS.CUR.REC.TRA"
    },
    {
      "Code": "800",
      "Name": "Accounts Payable",
      "Type": "CURRLIAB",
      "SystemAccount": "CREDITORS",
      "ReportingCode": "LIA.CUR.PAY"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="sets-the-chart-of-accounts-the-conversion-date-and-conversion-balances-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Idempotency-Key|header|string|false|This allows you to safely retry requests without the risk of duplicate processing. 128 character max.|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|
|body|body|[Setup](#schemasetup)|true|Object including an accounts array, a conversion balances array and a conversion date object in body of request|
|» ConversionDate|body|[ConversionDate](#schemaconversiondate)|false|The date when the organisation starts using Xero|
|» ConversionBalances|body|[[ConversionBalances](#schemaconversionbalances)]|false|Balance supplied for each account that has a value as at the conversion date.|
|» Accounts|body|[[Account](#schemaaccount)]|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Id": "80dcb65b-4d14-4350-84e6-1438a809244a",
  "Status": "OK",
  "ProviderName": "Java Public Example",
  "DateTimeUTC": "/Date(1604457589645)/",
  "ImportSummary": {
    "Accounts": {
      "Total": 17,
      "New": 0,
      "Updated": 8,
      "Deleted": 0,
      "Locked": 0,
      "System": 9,
      "Errored": 0,
      "Present": true,
      "NewOrUpdated": 8
    },
    "Organisation": {
      "Present": false
    }
  }
}
```

<h3 id="sets-the-chart-of-accounts-the-conversion-date-and-conversion-balances-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success - returns a summary of the chart of accounts updates|[ImportSummaryObject](#schemaimportsummaryobject)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2 ( Scopes: accounting.settings )
</aside>

## Retrieves tax rates

<a id="opIdgetTaxRates"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0/TaxRates \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -H 'xero-tenant-id: YOUR_XERO_TENANT_ID'
```

`GET /TaxRates`

<h3 id="retrieves-tax-rates-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|where|query|string|false|Filter by an any element|
|order|query|string|false|Order by an any element|
|xero-tenant-id|header|string|true|Xero identifier for Tenant|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "Id": "455d494d-9706-465b-b584-7086ca406b27",
  "Status": "OK",
  "ProviderName": "Provider Name Example",
  "DateTimeUTC": "/Date(1555086839841)/",
  "TaxRates": [
    {
      "Name": "15% GST on Expenses",
      "TaxType": "INPUT2",
      "ReportTaxType": "INPUT",
      "CanApplyToAssets": true,
      "CanApplyToEquity": true,
      "CanApplyToExpenses": true,
```

<h2 id="tocS_Account">Account</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaaccount"></a>
<a id="schema_Account"></a>
<a id="tocSaccount"></a>
<a id="tocsaccount"></a>

```json
{
  "Code": 4400,
  "Name": "Food Sales",
  "AccountID": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
  "Type": "BANK",
  "BankAccountNumber": "string",
  "Status": "ACTIVE",
  "Description": "string",
  "BankAccountType": "BANK",
  "CurrencyCode": "AED",
  "TaxType": "string",
  "EnablePaymentsToAccount": true,
  "ShowInExpenseClaims": true,
  "Class": "ASSET",
  "SystemAccount": "DEBTORS",
  "ReportingCode": "string",
  "ReportingCodeName": "string",
  "HasAttachments": "false",
  "UpdatedDateUTC": "/Date(1573755038314)/",
  "AddToWatchlist": true,
  "ValidationErrors": [
    {
      "Message": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Code|string|false|none|Customer defined alpha numeric account code e.g 200 or SALES (max length = 10)|
|Name|string|false|none|Name of account (max length = 150)|
|AccountID|string(uuid)|false|none|The Xero identifier for an account – specified as a string following  the endpoint name   e.g. /297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9|
|Type|[AccountType](#schemaaccounttype)|false|none|See Account Types|
|BankAccountNumber|string|false|none|For bank accounts only (Account Type BANK)|
|Status|string|false|none|Accounts with a status of ACTIVE can be updated to ARCHIVED. See Account Status Codes|
|Description|string|false|none|Description of the Account. Valid for all types of accounts except bank accounts (max length = 4000)|
|BankAccountType|string|false|none|For bank accounts only. See Bank Account types|
|CurrencyCode|[CurrencyCode](#schemacurrencycode)|false|none|3 letter alpha code for the currency – see list of currency codes|
|TaxType|string|false|none|The tax type from taxRates|
|EnablePaymentsToAccount|boolean|false|none|Boolean – describes whether account can have payments applied to it|
|ShowInExpenseClaims|boolean|false|none|Boolean – describes whether account code is available for use with expense claims|
|Class|string|false|read-only|See Account Class Types|
|SystemAccount|string|false|read-only|If this is a system account then this element is returned. See System Account types. Note that non-system accounts may have this element set as either “” or null.|
|ReportingCode|string|false|none|Shown if set|
|ReportingCodeName|string|false|read-only|Shown if set|
|HasAttachments|boolean|false|read-only|boolean to indicate if an account has an attachment (read only)|
|UpdatedDateUTC|string|false|read-only|Last modified date UTC format|
|AddToWatchlist|boolean|false|none|Boolean – describes whether the account is shown in the watchlist widget on the dashboard|
|ValidationErrors|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of validation error messages from the API|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|Type|BANK|
|Type|CURRENT|
|Type|CURRLIAB|
|Type|DEPRECIATN|
|Type|DIRECTCOSTS|
|Type|EQUITY|
|Type|EXPENSE|
|Type|FIXED|
|Type|INVENTORY|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Type|string|true|none|See Bank Transaction Types|
|Contact|[Contact](#schemacontact)|false|none|none|
|LineItems|[[LineItem](#schemalineitem)]|true|none|See LineItems|
|BankAccount|[Account](#schemaaccount)|true|none|none|
|IsReconciled|boolean|false|none|Boolean to show if transaction is reconciled|
|Date|string|false|none|Date of transaction – YYYY-MM-DD|
|Reference|string|false|none|Reference for the transaction. Only supported for SPEND and RECEIVE transactions.|
|CurrencyCode|[CurrencyCode](#schemacurrencycode)|false|none|3 letter alpha code for the currency – see list of currency codes|
|CurrencyRate|number(double)|false|none|Exchange rate to base currency when money is spent or received. e.g.0.7500 Only used for bank transactions in non base currency. If this isn’t specified for non base currency accounts then either the user-defined rate (preference) or the XE.com day rate will be used. Setting currency is only supported on overpayments.|
|Url|string|false|none|URL link to a source document – shown as “Go to App Name”|
|Status|string|false|none|See Bank Transaction Status Codes|
|LineAmountTypes|[LineAmountTypes](#schemalineamounttypes)|false|none|Line amounts are exclusive of tax by default if you don’t specify this element. See Line Amount Types|
|SubTotal|number(double)|false|none|Total of bank transaction excluding taxes|
|TotalTax|number(double)|false|none|Total tax on bank transaction|
|Total|number(double)|false|none|Total of bank transaction tax inclusive|
|BankTransactionID|string(uuid)|false|none|Xero generated unique identifier for bank transaction|
|PrepaymentID|string(uuid)|false|read-only|Xero generated unique identifier for a Prepayment. This will be returned on BankTransactions with a Type of SPEND-PREPAYMENT or RECEIVE-PREPAYMENT|
|OverpaymentID|string(uuid)|false|read-only|Xero generated unique identifier for an Overpayment. This will be returned on BankTransactions with a Type of SPEND-OVERPAYMENT or RECEIVE-OVERPAYMENT|
|UpdatedDateUTC|string|false|read-only|Last modified date UTC format|
|HasAttachments|boolean|false|read-only|Boolean to indicate if a bank transaction has an attachment|
|StatusAttributeString|string|false|none|A string to indicate if a invoice status|
|ValidationErrors|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of validation error messages from the API|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|LineItemID|string(uuid)|false|none|LineItem unique ID|
|Description|string|false|none|Description needs to be at least 1 char long. A line item with just a description (i.e no unit amount or quantity) can be created by specifying just a <Description> element that contains at least 1 character|
|Quantity|number(double)|false|none|LineItem Quantity|
|UnitAmount|number(double)|false|none|LineItem Unit Amount|
|ItemCode|string|false|none|See Items|
|AccountCode|string|false|none|See Accounts|
|AccountID|string(uuid)|false|none|The associated account ID related to this line item|
|TaxType|string|false|none|The tax type from TaxRates|
|TaxAmount|number(double)|false|none|The tax amount is auto calculated as a percentage of the line amount (see below) based on the tax rate. This value can be overriden if the calculated <TaxAmount> is not correct.|
|Item|[LineItemItem](#schemalineitemitem)|false|none|none|
|LineAmount|number(double)|false|none|If you wish to omit either the Quantity or UnitAmount you can provide a LineAmount and Xero will calculate the missing amount for you. The line amount reflects the discounted price if either a DiscountRate or DiscountAmount has been used i.e. LineAmount = Quantity * Unit Amount * ((100 - DiscountRate)/100) or LineAmount = (Quantity * UnitAmount) - DiscountAmount|
|Tracking|[[LineItemTracking](#schemalineitemtracking)]|false|none|Optional Tracking Category – see Tracking.  Any LineItem can have a  maximum of 2 <TrackingCategory> elements.|
|DiscountRate|number(double)|false|none|Percentage discount being applied to a line item (only supported on  ACCREC invoices – ACC PAY invoices and credit notes in Xero do not support discounts|
|DiscountAmount|number(double)|false|none|Discount amount being applied to a line item. Only supported on ACCREC invoices and quotes. ACCPAY invoices and credit notes in Xero do not support discounts.|
|RepeatingInvoiceID|string(uuid)|false|none|The Xero identifier for a Repeating Invoice|
|Taxability|string|false|none|The type of taxability|
|SalesTaxCodeId|number|false|none|The ID of the sales tax code|
|TaxBreakdown|[[TaxBreakdownComponent](#schemataxbreakdowncomponent)]|false|none|An array of tax components defined for this line item|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|Taxability|TAXABLE|
|Taxability|NON_TAXABLE|
|Taxability|EXEMPT|
|Taxability|PART_TAXABLE|
|Taxability|NOT_APPLICABLE|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ContactID|string(uuid)|false|none|Xero identifier|
|MergedToContactID|string(uuid)|false|none|ID for the destination of a merged contact. Only returned when using paging or when fetching a contact by ContactId or ContactNumber.|
|ContactNumber|string|false|none|This can be updated via the API only i.e. This field is read only on the Xero contact screen, used to identify contacts in external systems (max length = 50). If the Contact Number is used, this is displayed as Contact Code in the Contacts UI in Xero.|
|AccountNumber|string|false|none|A user defined account number. This can be updated via the API and the Xero UI (max length = 50)|
|ContactStatus|string|false|none|Current status of a contact – see contact status types|
|Name|string|false|none|Full name of contact/organisation (max length = 255)|
|FirstName|string|false|none|First name of contact person (max length = 255)|
|LastName|string|false|none|Last name of contact person (max length = 255)|
|CompanyNumber|string|false|none|Company registration number (max length = 50)|
|EmailAddress|string|false|none|Email address of contact person (umlauts not supported) (max length  = 255)|
|ContactPersons|[[ContactPerson](#schemacontactperson)]|false|none|See contact persons|
|BankAccountDetails|string|false|none|Bank account number of contact|
|TaxNumber|string|false|none|Tax number of contact – this is also known as the ABN (Australia), GST Number (New Zealand), VAT Number (UK) or Tax ID Number (US and global) in the Xero UI depending on which regionalized version of Xero you are using (max length = 50)|
|TaxNumberType|string|false|none|Identifier of the regional type of tax number, such as US, UK, or other regional tax identifiers|
|AccountsReceivableTaxType|string|false|none|The tax type from TaxRates|
|AccountsPayableTaxType|string|false|none|The tax type from TaxRates|
|Addresses|[[Address](#schemaaddress)]|false|none|Store certain address types for a contact – see address types|
|Phones|[[Phone](#schemaphone)]|false|none|Store certain phone types for a contact – see phone types|
|IsSupplier|boolean|false|none|true or false – Boolean that describes if a contact that has any AP  invoices entered against them. Cannot be set via PUT or POST – it is automatically set when an accounts payable invoice is generated against this contact.|
|IsCustomer|boolean|false|none|true or false – Boolean that describes if a contact has any AR invoices entered against them. Cannot be set via PUT or POST – it is automatically set when an accounts receivable invoice is generated against this contact.|
|SalesDefaultLineAmountType|string|false|none|The default sales line amount type for a contact. Only available when summaryOnly parameter or paging is used, or when fetch by ContactId or ContactNumber.|
|PurchasesDefaultLineAmountType|string|false|none|The default purchases line amount type for a contact Only available when summaryOnly parameter or paging is used, or when fetch by ContactId or ContactNumber.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Type|string|false|none|See Credit Note Types|
|Contact|[Contact](#schemacontact)|false|none|none|
|Date|string|false|none|The date the credit note is issued YYYY-MM-DD. If the Date element is not specified then it will default to the current date based on the timezone setting of the organisation|
|DueDate|string|false|none|Date invoice is due – YYYY-MM-DD|
|Status|string|false|none|See Credit Note Status Codes|
|LineAmountTypes|[LineAmountTypes](#schemalineamounttypes)|false|none|Line amounts are exclusive of tax by default if you don’t specify this element. See Line Amount Types|
|LineItems|[[LineItem](#schemalineitem)]|false|none|See Invoice Line Items|
|SubTotal|number(double)|false|none|The subtotal of the credit note excluding taxes|
|TotalTax|number(double)|false|none|The total tax on the credit note|
|Total|number(double)|false|none|The total of the Credit Note(subtotal + total tax)|
|CISDeduction|number(double)|false|read-only|CIS deduction for UK contractors|
|CISRate|number(double)|false|read-only|CIS Deduction rate for the organisation|
|UpdatedDateUTC|string|false|read-only|UTC timestamp of last update to the credit note|
|UpdatedDateUTCString|string|false|read-only|UTC ISO-8601 formatted timestamp of last update to the credit note|
|CurrencyCode|[CurrencyCode](#schemacurrencycode)|false|none|The specified currency code|
|FullyPaidOnDate|string|false|none|Date when credit note was fully paid(UTC format)|
|CreditNoteID|string(uuid)|false|none|Xero generated unique identifier|
|CreditNoteNumber|string|false|none|ACCRECCREDIT – Unique alpha numeric code identifying credit note (when missing will auto-generate from your Organisation Invoice Settings)|
|Reference|string|false|none|ACCRECCREDIT only – additional reference number|
|SentToContact|boolean|false|none|Boolean to set whether the credit note in the Xero app should be marked as “sent”. This can be set only on credit notes that have been approved|
|CurrencyRate|number(double)|false|none|The currency rate for a multicurrency invoice. If no rate is specified, the XE.com day rate is used|
|RemainingCredit|number(double)|false|none|The remaining credit balance on the Credit Note|
|Allocations|[[Allocation](#schemaallocation)]|false|none|See Allocations|
|AppliedAmount|number(double)|false|none|The amount of applied to an invoice|
|Payments|[[Payment](#schemapayment)]|false|none|See Payments|
|BrandingThemeID|string(uuid)|false|none|See BrandingThemes|
|StatusAttributeString|string|false|none|A string to indicate if a invoice status|
|HasAttachments|boolean|false|none|boolean to indicate if a credit note has an attachment|
|HasErrors|boolean|false|none|A boolean to indicate if a credit note has an validation errors|
|ValidationErrors|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of validation error messages from the API|
|Warnings|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of warning messages from the API|
|InvoiceAddresses|[[InvoiceAddress](#schemainvoiceaddress)]|false|none|An array of addresses used to auto calculate sales tax|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ExpenseClaimID|string(uuid)|false|none|Xero generated unique identifier for an expense claim|
|Status|string|false|none|Current status of an expense claim – see status types|
|Payments|[[Payment](#schemapayment)]|false|none|See Payments|
|User|[User](#schemauser)|false|none|none|
|Receipts|[[Receipt](#schemareceipt)]|false|none|none|
|UpdatedDateUTC|string|false|read-only|Last modified date UTC format|
|Total|number(double)|false|read-only|The total of an expense claim being paid|
|AmountDue|number(double)|false|read-only|The amount due to be paid for an expense claim|
|AmountPaid|number(double)|false|read-only|The amount still to pay for an expense claim|
|PaymentDueDate|string|false|read-only|The date when the expense claim is due to be paid YYYY-MM-DD|
|ReportingDate|string|false|read-only|The date the expense claim will be reported in Xero YYYY-MM-DD|
|ReceiptID|string(uuid)|false|none|The Xero identifier for the Receipt e.g. e59a2c7f-1306-4078-a0f3-73537afcbba9|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|Status|SUBMITTED|
|Status|AUTHORISED|
|Status|PAID|
|Status|VOIDED|
|Status|DELETED|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Type|string|false|none|See Invoice Types|
|Contact|[Contact](#schemacontact)|false|none|none|
|LineItems|[[LineItem](#schemalineitem)]|false|none|See LineItems|
|Date|string|false|none|Date invoice was issued – YYYY-MM-DD. If the Date element is not specified it will default to the current date based on the timezone setting of the organisation|
|DueDate|string|false|none|Date invoice is due – YYYY-MM-DD|
|LineAmountTypes|[LineAmountTypes](#schemalineamounttypes)|false|none|Line amounts are exclusive of tax by default if you don’t specify this element. See Line Amount Types|
|InvoiceNumber|string|false|none|ACCREC – Unique alpha numeric code identifying invoice (when missing will auto-generate from your Organisation Invoice Settings) (max length = 255)|
|Reference|string|false|none|ACCREC only – additional reference number|
|BrandingThemeID|string(uuid)|false|none|See BrandingThemes|
|Url|string|false|none|URL link to a source document – shown as “Go to [appName]” in the Xero app|
|CurrencyCode|[CurrencyCode](#schemacurrencycode)|false|none|3 letter alpha code for the currency – see list of currency codes|
|CurrencyRate|number(double)|false|none|The currency rate for a multicurrency invoice. If no rate is specified, the XE.com day rate is used. (max length = [18].[6])|
|Status|string|false|none|See Invoice Status Codes|
|SentToContact|boolean|false|none|Boolean to set whether the invoice in the Xero app should be marked as “sent”. This can be set only on invoices that have been approved|
|ExpectedPaymentDate|string|false|none|Shown on sales invoices (Accounts Receivable) when this has been set|
|PlannedPaymentDate|string|false|none|Shown on bills (Accounts Payable) when this has been set|
|CISDeduction|number(double)|false|read-only|CIS deduction for UK contractors|
|CISRate|number(double)|false|read-only|CIS Deduction rate for the organisation|
|SubTotal|number(double)|false|none|Total of invoice excluding taxes. Calculated automatically by Xero from the invoice's line items. Only for ACCPAY and ACCREC invoices, where this opt-in capability is enabled for your organisation, can SubTotal be supplied on write – on a SUBMITTED or AUTHORISED invoice supplied together with TotalTax and Total, it is validated against the calculated line item totals (see RoundingAmount); it is ignored in all other cases. This write behaviour, and the returned value reflecting it, only applies to the Create and Update endpoints (POST/PUT) and to retrieving a single invoice by ID (GET by ID) – it does not apply when listing invoices (GET)<br>|
|TotalTax|number(double)|false|none|Total tax on invoice. Calculated automatically by Xero from the invoice's line items. Only for ACCPAY and ACCREC invoices, where this opt-in capability is enabled for your organisation, can TotalTax be supplied on write – on a SUBMITTED or AUTHORISED invoice supplied together with SubTotal and Total, it is validated against the calculated line item totals (see RoundingAmount); it is ignored in all other cases. This write behaviour, and the returned value reflecting it, only applies to the Create and Update endpoints (POST/PUT) and to retrieving a single invoice by ID (GET by ID) – it does not apply when listing invoices (GET)<br>|
|Total|number(double)|false|none|Total of Invoice tax inclusive (i.e. SubTotal + TotalTax + RoundingAmount). Calculated automatically by Xero from the invoice's line items. Only for ACCPAY and ACCREC invoices, where this opt-in capability is enabled for your organisation, can Total be supplied on write – on a SUBMITTED or AUTHORISED invoice supplied together with SubTotal and TotalTax, it is validated against the calculated line item totals plus RoundingAmount; in all other cases this will be ignored if it does not equal the sum of the LineAmounts. This write behaviour, and the returned value reflecting it, only applies to the Create and Update endpoints (POST/PUT) and to retrieving a single invoice by ID (GET by ID) – it does not apply when listing invoices (GET)<br>|
|TotalDiscount|number(double)|false|read-only|Total of discounts applied on the invoice line items|
|RoundingAmount|number(double)|false|none|An optional rounding adjustment added to SubTotal + TotalTax to give Total (i.e. Total = SubTotal + TotalTax + RoundingAmount). Only applies to ACCPAY and ACCREC invoices, and only if this opt-in capability has been enabled for your organisation. Not validated while the invoice is DRAFT. For SUBMITTED and AUTHORISED invoices, RoundingAmount is only applied when SubTotal, TotalTax and Total are all supplied together, and must be between -0.10 and 0.10 – values outside this range are rejected with a validation error (on DRAFT invoices, an out-of-range value is ignored instead). This field is only settable and only returned via the Create and Update endpoints (POST/PUT) and when retrieving a single invoice by ID (GET by ID) – it is not returned when listing invoices (GET)<br>|
|EnteredTotal|number(double)|false|none|The total amount as originally entered for the invoice, before any RoundingAmount adjustment is applied. Only applies to ACCPAY and ACCREC invoices, and only if this opt-in capability has been enabled for your organisation. Can only be set while the invoice is DRAFT; once the invoice is no longer DRAFT this reflects Total. This field is only settable and only returned via the Create and Update endpoints (POST/PUT) and when retrieving a single invoice by ID (GET by ID) – it is not returned when listing invoices (GET)<br>|
|InvoiceID|string(uuid)|false|none|Xero generated unique identifier for invoice|
|RepeatingInvoiceID|string(uuid)|false|none|Xero generated unique identifier for repeating invoices|
|HasAttachments|boolean|false|read-only|boolean to indicate if an invoice has an attachment|
|IsDiscounted|boolean|false|read-only|boolean to indicate if an invoice has a discount|
|Payments|[[Payment](#schemapayment)]|false|read-only|See Payments|
|Prepayments|[[Prepayment](#schemaprepayment)]|false|read-only|See Prepayments|
|Overpayments|[[Overpayment](#schemaoverpayment)]|false|read-only|See Overpayments|
|AmountDue|number(double)|false|read-only|Amount remaining to be paid on invoice|
|AmountPaid|number(double)|false|read-only|Sum of payments received for invoice|
|FullyPaidOnDate|string|false|read-only|The date the invoice was fully paid. Only returned on fully paid invoices|
|AmountCredited|number(double)|false|read-only|Sum of all credit notes, over-payments and pre-payments applied to invoice|
|UpdatedDateUTC|string|false|read-only|UTC timestamp of last update to the invoice|
|UpdatedDateUTCString|string|false|read-only|UTC ISO-8601 formatted timestamp of last update to the invoice|
|CreditNotes|[[CreditNote](#schemacreditnote)]|false|read-only|Details of credit notes that have been applied to an invoice|
|Attachments|[[Attachment](#schemaattachment)]|false|none|Displays array of attachments from the API|
|HasErrors|boolean|false|none|A boolean to indicate if a invoice has an validation errors|
|StatusAttributeString|string|false|none|A string to indicate if a invoice status|
|ValidationErrors|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of validation error messages from the API|
|Warnings|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of warning messages from the API|
|InvoiceAddresses|[[InvoiceAddress](#schemainvoiceaddress)]|false|none|An array of addresses used to auto calculate sales tax|

<!-- backwards compatibility -->

<a id="tocsitem"></a>

```json
{
  "Code": "string",
  "InventoryAssetAccountCode": "string",
  "Name": "string",
  "IsSold": true,
  "IsPurchased": true,
  "Description": "string",
  "PurchaseDescription": "string",
  "PurchaseDetails": {
    "UnitPrice": 0,
    "AccountCode": "string",
    "COGSAccountCode": "string",
    "TaxType": "string"
  },
  "SalesDetails": {
    "UnitPrice": 0,
    "AccountCode": "string",
    "COGSAccountCode": "string",
    "TaxType": "string"
  },
  "IsTrackedAsInventory": true,
  "TotalCostPool": 0,
  "QuantityOnHand": 0,
  "QuantityAvailable": 0,
  "QuantityOnBackOrder": 0,
  "UpdatedDateUTC": "/Date(1573755038314)/",
  "ItemID": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "StatusAttributeString": "string",
  "ValidationErrors": [
    {
      "Message": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Code|string|true|none|User defined item code (max length = 30)|
|InventoryAssetAccountCode|string|false|none|The inventory asset account for the item. The account must be of type INVENTORY. The  COGSAccountCode in PurchaseDetails is also required to create a tracked item|
|Name|string|false|none|The name of the item (max length = 50)|
|IsSold|boolean|false|none|Boolean value, defaults to true. When IsSold is true the item will be available on sales transactions in the Xero UI. If IsSold is updated to false then Description and SalesDetails values will be nulled.|
|IsPurchased|boolean|false|none|Boolean value, defaults to true. When IsPurchased is true the item is available for purchase transactions in the Xero UI. If IsPurchased is updated to false then PurchaseDescription and PurchaseDetails values will be nulled.|
|Description|string|false|none|The sales description of the item (max length = 4000)|
|PurchaseDescription|string|false|none|The purchase description of the item (max length = 4000)|
|PurchaseDetails|[Purchase](#schemapurchase)|false|none|none|
|SalesDetails|[Purchase](#schemapurchase)|false|none|none|
|IsTrackedAsInventory|boolean|false|none|True for items that are tracked as inventory. An item will be tracked as inventory if the InventoryAssetAccountCode and COGSAccountCode are set.|
|TotalCostPool|number(double)|false|none|The value of the item on hand. Calculated using average cost accounting.|
|QuantityOnHand|number(double)|false|none|The quantity of the item on hand. This will be 0 if `QuantityOnBackOrder` is greater than 0.|
|QuantityAvailable|number(double)|false|read-only|The quantity of the item available. This is equal to `QuantityOnHand` - `QuantityOnBackOrder`. This value will be negative if `QuantityOnBackOrder` is greater than 0.|
|QuantityOnBackOrder|number(double)|false|read-only|The quantity of the item on backorder. This will be 0 if `QuantityOnHand` is greater than 0.|
|UpdatedDateUTC|string|false|read-only|Last modified date in UTC format|
|ItemID|string(uuid)|false|none|The Xero identifier for an Item|
|StatusAttributeString|string|false|none|Status of object|
|ValidationErrors|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of validation error messages from the API|

```json
  "Status": "APPROVED",
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|SourceTransactionID|string(uuid)|false|none|Filter by the SourceTransactionID. Get all the linked transactions created from a particular ACCPAY invoice|
|SourceLineItemID|string(uuid)|false|none|The line item identifier from the source transaction.|
|ContactID|string(uuid)|false|none|Filter by the combination of ContactID and Status. Get all the linked transactions that have been assigned to a particular customer and have a particular status e.g. GET /LinkedTransactions?ContactID=4bb34b03-3378-4bb2-a0ed-6345abf3224e&Status=APPROVED.|
|TargetTransactionID|string(uuid)|false|none|Filter by the TargetTransactionID. Get all the linked transactions  allocated to a particular ACCREC invoice|
|TargetLineItemID|string(uuid)|false|none|The line item identifier from the target transaction. It is possible  to link multiple billable expenses to the same TargetLineItemID.|
|LinkedTransactionID|string(uuid)|false|none|The Xero identifier for an Linked Transaction e.g./LinkedTransactions/297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9|
|Status|string|false|none|Filter by the combination of ContactID and Status. Get all the linked transactions that have been assigned to a particular customer and have a particular status e.g. GET /LinkedTransactions?ContactID=4bb34b03-3378-4bb2-a0ed-6345abf3224e&Status=APPROVED.|
|Type|string|false|none|This will always be BILLABLEEXPENSE. More types may be added in future.|
|UpdatedDateUTC|string|false|read-only|The last modified date in UTC format|
|SourceTransactionTypeCode|string|false|none|The Type of the source tranasction. This will be ACCPAY if the linked transaction was created from an invoice and SPEND if it was created from a bank transaction.|
|ValidationErrors|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of validation error messages from the API|

#### Enumerated Values

|---|---|
|Status|APPROVED|
|Status|DRAFT|
|Status|ONDRAFT|
|Status|BILLED|
|Status|VOIDED|
|Type|BILLABLEEXPENSE|
|SourceTransactionTypeCode|ACCPAY|
|SourceTransactionTypeCode|SPEND|
