|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Type|string|false|none|See Overpayment Types|
|Contact|[Contact](#schemacontact)|false|none|none|
|Date|string|false|none|The date the overpayment is created YYYY-MM-DD|
|Status|string|false|none|See Overpayment Status Codes|
|LineAmountTypes|[LineAmountTypes](#schemalineamounttypes)|false|none|Line amounts are exclusive of tax by default if you don’t specify this element. See Line Amount Types|
|LineItems|[[LineItem](#schemalineitem)]|false|none|See Overpayment Line Items|
|SubTotal|number(double)|false|none|The subtotal of the overpayment excluding taxes|
|TotalTax|number(double)|false|none|The total tax on the overpayment|
|Total|number(double)|false|none|The total of the overpayment (subtotal + total tax)|
|UpdatedDateUTC|string|false|read-only|UTC timestamp of last update to the overpayment|
|UpdatedDateUTCString|string|false|read-only|UTC ISO-8601 formatted timestamp of last update to the overpayment|
|CurrencyCode|[CurrencyCode](#schemacurrencycode)|false|none|3 letter alpha code for the currency – see list of currency codes|
|OverpaymentID|string(uuid)|false|none|Xero generated unique identifier|
|CurrencyRate|number(double)|false|none|The currency rate for a multicurrency overpayment. If no rate is specified, the XE.com day rate is used|
|RemainingCredit|number(double)|false|none|The remaining credit balance on the overpayment|
|Allocations|[[Allocation](#schemaallocation)]|false|none|See Allocations|
|AppliedAmount|number(double)|false|none|The amount of applied to an invoice|
|Payments|[[Payment](#schemapayment)]|false|none|See Payments|
|HasAttachments|boolean|false|read-only|boolean to indicate if a overpayment has an attachment|
|Reference|string|false|none|An optional description for Overpayment|
|Attachments|[[Attachment](#schemaattachment)]|false|none|See Attachments|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Invoice|[Invoice](#schemainvoice)|false|none|none|
|CreditNote|[CreditNote](#schemacreditnote)|false|none|none|
|Prepayment|[Prepayment](#schemaprepayment)|false|none|none|
|Overpayment|[Overpayment](#schemaoverpayment)|false|none|none|
|InvoiceNumber|string|false|none|Number of invoice or credit note you are applying payment to e.g.INV-4003|
|CreditNoteNumber|string|false|none|Number of invoice or credit note you are applying payment to e.g. INV-4003|
|BatchPayment|[BatchPayment](#schemabatchpayment)|false|none|none|
|Account|[Account](#schemaaccount)|false|none|none|
|Code|string|false|none|Code of account you are using to make the payment e.g. 001 (note- not all accounts have a code value)|
|Date|string|false|none|Date the payment is being made (YYYY-MM-DD) e.g. 2009-09-06|
|CurrencyRate|number(double)|false|none|Exchange rate when payment is received. Only used for non base currency invoices and credit notes e.g. 0.7500|
|Amount|number(double)|false|none|The amount of the payment. Must be less than or equal to the outstanding amount owing on the invoice e.g. 200.00|
|BankAmount|number(double)|false|none|The amount of the payment in the currency of the bank account.|
|Reference|string|false|none|An optional description for the payment e.g. Direct Debit|
|IsReconciled|boolean|false|none|An optional parameter for the payment. A boolean indicating whether you would like the payment to be created as reconciled when using PUT, or whether a payment has been reconciled when using GET|
|Status|string|false|none|The status of the payment.|
|PaymentType|string|false|read-only|See Payment Types.|
|UpdatedDateUTC|string|false|read-only|UTC timestamp of last update to the payment|
|UpdatedDateUTCString|string|false|read-only|UTC ISO-8601 formatted timestamp of last update to the payment|
|PaymentID|string(uuid)|false|none|The Xero identifier for an Payment e.g. 297c2dc5-cc47-4afd-8ec8-74990b8761e9|
|BatchPaymentID|string(uuid)|false|none|Present if the payment was created as part of a batch.|
|BankAccountNumber|string|false|none|The suppliers bank account number the payment is being made to|
|Particulars|string|false|none|The suppliers bank account number the payment is being made to|
|Details|string|false|none|The information to appear on the supplier's bank account|
|HasAccount|boolean|false|none|A boolean to indicate if a contact has an validation errors|
|HasValidationErrors|boolean|false|none|A boolean to indicate if a contact has an validation errors|
|StatusAttributeString|string|false|none|A string to indicate if a invoice status|
|ValidationErrors|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of validation error messages from the API|
|Warnings|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of warning messages from the API|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Type|string|false|none|See Prepayment Types|
|Contact|[Contact](#schemacontact)|false|none|none|
|Date|string|false|none|The date the prepayment is created YYYY-MM-DD|
|Status|string|false|none|See Prepayment Status Codes|
|LineAmountTypes|[LineAmountTypes](#schemalineamounttypes)|false|none|Line amounts are exclusive of tax by default if you don’t specify this element. See Line Amount Types|
|LineItems|[[LineItem](#schemalineitem)]|false|none|See Prepayment Line Items|
|SubTotal|number(double)|false|none|The subtotal of the prepayment excluding taxes|
|TotalTax|number(double)|false|none|The total tax on the prepayment|
|Total|number(double)|false|none|The total of the prepayment(subtotal + total tax)|
|Reference|string|false|read-only|Returns Invoice number field. Reference field isn't available.|
|InvoiceNumber|string|false|read-only|Returns Invoice number for prepayment receive document only.|
|UpdatedDateUTC|string|false|read-only|UTC timestamp of last update to the prepayment|
|UpdatedDateUTCString|string|false|read-only|UTC ISO-8601 formatted timestamp of last update to the prepayment|
|CurrencyCode|[CurrencyCode](#schemacurrencycode)|false|none|3 letter alpha code for the currency – see list of currency codes|
|PrepaymentID|string(uuid)|false|none|Xero generated unique identifier|
|BrandingThemeID|string(uuid)|false|read-only|The unique identifier of the branding template applied to a receive prepayment|
|CurrencyRate|number(double)|false|none|The currency rate for a multicurrency prepayment. If no rate is specified, the XE.com day rate is used|
|RemainingCredit|number(double)|false|none|The remaining credit balance on the prepayment|
|Allocations|[[Allocation](#schemaallocation)]|false|none|See Allocations|
|Payments|[[Payment](#schemapayment)]|false|none|See Payments|
|AppliedAmount|number(double)|false|none|The amount of applied to an invoice|
|HasAttachments|boolean|false|read-only|boolean to indicate if a prepayment has an attachment|
|Attachments|[[Attachment](#schemaattachment)]|false|none|See Attachments|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Contact|[Contact](#schemacontact)|false|none|none|
|LineItems|[[LineItem](#schemalineitem)]|false|none|See LineItems|
|Date|string|false|none|Date purchase order was issued – YYYY-MM-DD. If the Date element is not specified then it will default to the current date based on the timezone setting of the organisation|
|DeliveryDate|string|false|none|Date the goods are to be delivered – YYYY-MM-DD|
|LineAmountTypes|[LineAmountTypes](#schemalineamounttypes)|false|none|Line amounts are exclusive of tax by default if you don’t specify this element. See Line Amount Types|
|PurchaseOrderNumber|string|false|none|Unique alpha numeric code identifying purchase order (when missing will auto-generate from your Organisation Invoice Settings)|
|Reference|string|false|none|Additional reference number|
|BrandingThemeID|string(uuid)|false|none|See BrandingThemes|
|CurrencyCode|[CurrencyCode](#schemacurrencycode)|false|none|3 letter alpha code for the currency – see list of currency codes|
|Status|string|false|none|See Purchase Order Status Codes|
|SentToContact|boolean|false|none|Boolean to set whether the purchase order should be marked as “sent”. This can be set only on purchase orders that have been approved or billed|
|DeliveryAddress|string|false|none|The address the goods are to be delivered to|
|AttentionTo|string|false|none|The person that the delivery is going to|
|Telephone|string|false|none|The phone number for the person accepting the delivery|
|DeliveryInstructions|string|false|none|A free text feild for instructions (500 characters max)|
|ExpectedArrivalDate|string|false|none|The date the goods are expected to arrive.|
|PurchaseOrderID|string(uuid)|false|none|Xero generated unique identifier for purchase order|
|CurrencyRate|number(double)|false|none|The currency rate for a multicurrency purchase order. If no rate is specified, the XE.com day rate is used.|
|SubTotal|number(double)|false|read-only|Total of purchase order excluding taxes|
|TotalTax|number(double)|false|read-only|Total tax on purchase order|
|Total|number(double)|false|read-only|Total of Purchase Order tax inclusive (i.e. SubTotal + TotalTax)|
|TotalDiscount|number(double)|false|read-only|Total of discounts applied on the purchase order line items|
|HasAttachments|boolean|false|read-only|boolean to indicate if a purchase order has an attachment|
|UpdatedDateUTC|string|false|read-only|Last modified date UTC format|
|StatusAttributeString|string|false|none|A string to indicate if a invoice status|
|ValidationErrors|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of validation error messages from the API|
|Warnings|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of warning messages from the API|
|Attachments|[[Attachment](#schemaattachment)]|false|none|Displays array of attachments from the API|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|QuoteID|string(uuid)|false|none|QuoteID GUID is automatically generated and is returned after create or GET.|
|QuoteNumber|string|false|none|Unique alpha numeric code identifying a quote (Max Length = 255)|
|Reference|string|false|none|Additional reference number|
|Terms|string|false|none|Terms of the quote|
|Contact|[Contact](#schemacontact)|false|none|none|
|LineItems|[[LineItem](#schemalineitem)]|false|none|See LineItems|
|Date|string|false|none|Date quote was issued – YYYY-MM-DD. If the Date element is not specified it will default to the current date based on the timezone setting of the organisation|
|DateString|string|false|none|Date the quote was issued (YYYY-MM-DD)|
|ExpiryDate|string|false|none|Date the quote expires – YYYY-MM-DD.|
|ExpiryDateString|string|false|none|Date the quote expires – YYYY-MM-DD.|
|Status|[QuoteStatusCodes](#schemaquotestatuscodes)|false|none|The status of the quote.|
|CurrencyCode|[CurrencyCode](#schemacurrencycode)|false|none|3 letter alpha code for the currency – see list of currency codes|
|CurrencyRate|number(double)|false|none|The currency rate for a multicurrency quote|
|SubTotal|number(double)|false|read-only|Total of quote excluding taxes.|
|TotalTax|number(double)|false|read-only|Total tax on quote|
|Total|number(double)|false|read-only|Total of Quote tax inclusive (i.e. SubTotal + TotalTax). This will be ignored if it doesn’t equal the sum of the LineAmounts|
|TotalDiscount|number(double)|false|read-only|Total of discounts applied on the quote line items|
|Title|string|false|none|Title text for the quote|
|Summary|string|false|none|Summary text for the quote|
|BrandingThemeID|string(uuid)|false|none|See BrandingThemes|
|UpdatedDateUTC|string|false|read-only|Last modified date UTC format|
|LineAmountTypes|[QuoteLineAmountTypes](#schemaquotelineamounttypes)|false|none|See Quote Line Amount Types|
|StatusAttributeString|string|false|none|A string to indicate if a invoice status|
|ValidationErrors|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of validation error messages from the API|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Date|string|false|none|Date of receipt – YYYY-MM-DD|
|Contact|[Contact](#schemacontact)|false|none|none|
|LineItems|[[LineItem](#schemalineitem)]|false|none|none|
|User|[User](#schemauser)|false|none|none|
|Reference|string|false|none|Additional reference number|
|LineAmountTypes|[LineAmountTypes](#schemalineamounttypes)|false|none|Line amounts are exclusive of tax by default if you don’t specify this element. See Line Amount Types|
|SubTotal|number(double)|false|none|Total of receipt excluding taxes|
|TotalTax|number(double)|false|none|Total tax on receipt|
|Total|number(double)|false|none|Total of receipt tax inclusive (i.e. SubTotal + TotalTax)|
|ReceiptID|string(uuid)|false|none|Xero generated unique identifier for receipt|
|Status|string|false|none|Current status of receipt – see status types|
|ReceiptNumber|string|false|read-only|Xero generated sequence number for receipt in current claim for a given user|
|UpdatedDateUTC|string|false|read-only|Last modified date UTC format|
|HasAttachments|boolean|false|read-only|boolean to indicate if a receipt has an attachment|
|Url|string|false|read-only|URL link to a source document – shown as “Go to [appName]” in the Xero app|
|ValidationErrors|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of validation error messages from the API|
|Warnings|[[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)]|false|none|Displays array of warning messages from the API|
|Attachments|[[Attachment](#schemaattachment)]|false|none|Displays array of attachments from the API|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|LineAmountTypes|Exclusive|
|LineAmountTypes|Inclusive|
|LineAmountTypes|NoTax|
|Status|DRAFT|
|Status|SUBMITTED|
|Status|AUTHORISED|
|Status|DECLINED|
|Status|VOIDED|
